newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: Polish general to head U.N. observers in Tajikistan.
newsitem.headline: Polish general to head U.N. observers in Tajikistan.

text.p: Brigadier-General Boleslaw Izydorczyk of Poland has been named the new commander of the U.N. observer mission in civil war-torn Tajikistan, the United Nations said on Tuesday.
He succeeds Brigadier-General Hasan Abaza of Jordan who relinquished the post on Dec. 31 after more than two years' service.
The U.N. Mission of Observers in Tajikistan (UNMOT) consists of several dozen observers who work with a much larger peacekeeping force fielded by Russia and the Commonwealth of Independent States.
Tens of thousand of people have been killed in a four-year civil war between Tajikistan's secular government and Islamist guerrillas, spawned by the collapse of the Soviet Union.
The two sides signed an accord in Tehran earlier this month but failed to resolve all their differences.
